IntersectionObserver asynchronously reports changes when observed targets cross visibility thresholds
relative to a root or viewport. It is useful for lazy loading and infinite scrolling.

Interview question: Why use IntersectionObserver instead of scroll polling?

Answer: It observes visibility asynchronously without manually checking geometry on every scroll
event.
Remember: Observe visibility, not every scroll.
Practice: Disconnect the observer once the final page is loaded.
